column3: We hired a contractor to fix our kitchen last month. (我們上個月請了一位承包商來修理廚房。)
You must comply with the safety rules in the factory. (你必須遵守工廠的安全規定。)
The jury will convict him if they find enough evidence. (如果陪審團找到足夠的證據，他們將會判他有罪。)
The flu can be deadly for very young children. (流感對年幼的孩子來說可能是致命的。)
I am waiting for a response to my email. (我正在等待對我電子郵件的回覆。)
The government official will visit our office tomorrow. (政府官員明天將會拜訪我們的辦公室。)
The hotel has a great fitness facility for guests. (這家飯店為房客提供了很棒的健身設施。)
The police tried to intercept the package before it arrived. (警方試圖在包裹送達前將其攔截。)
The large vessel carried goods across the ocean. (這艘大型船隻載運貨物橫跨海洋。)
The dog will not attack if you stay calm. (如果你保持冷靜，那隻狗就不會攻擊你。)
